title: Rig: show "Not connected yet" when the service token is missing
head: codex/rig-not-connected
body:
## What

When the Rig's keychain token is missing or unreadable, `App.tsx` calls `getServiceTokenState()` at startup and shows the `NotConnectedYet` screen on any `get_service_token` failure. The screen displays:
- Title: "Not connected yet"
- Message: "The agent service isn't set up on this Mac yet." (adapts to "PC" on Windows, "computer" otherwise via `src/lib/deviceLabel.ts`)

The screen never mentions tokens, keychains, or technical details. If the token exists but the service is down, behavior is unchanged.

Files changed: `src/App.tsx`, `src/lib/serviceClient.ts`, `src/components/NotConnectedYet.tsx`, `src/lib/deviceLabel.ts`, `tests/App.test.tsx`, `tests/NotConnectedYet.test.tsx`, `tests/deviceLabel.test.ts`, `CHANGELOG.md`.

## Not done: activity-log line (needs a decision)

Braden asked for the technical reason written to the activity log. The Rig cannot do this: Tauri allows only reading text files, and it learns the `log.jsonl` path only from `GET /paths/log`, which is unreachable when not set up.

Coordinator recommendation: have `agent-core` write the reason to `log.jsonl` when it starts and finds no `rig.service_token`—a small follow-up.
